name: Sono Bestie
blurb: The pocket companion for ultrasound techs. Study with real scans, look things up between patients, find sonographer jobs and take care of yourself.
features: Image quizzes, flashcards and registry practice, built on real ultrasound images.
Look up a finding between patients: anatomy, pathology, measurements and protocols.
Sonographer openings from employers across the country, plus a resume builder.
Posture and break reminders, water tracking and breathing exercises.

name: Out The Chat
blurb: Stay with your group at concerts, festivals and wherever the night goes. A live map of your crew, routes to each other, ride requests and arrival alerts.
features: Everyone on one map, with a status you set yourself.
Tap a friend and get a route to them.
Ask who's driving home. They accept, you see them on the way.
Know when someone gets home. Your crew can always see which alerts are set.
note: Out The Chat supplements emergency services and venue security. It never replaces them.

name: Back 2 The Past
tagline: Your camera roll, ten minutes at a time.
blurb: Sort your photos and videos in quick 5 to 30 minute sessions, then post them. Everything is processed on your phone.

name: XAELO BOX
tagline: Run the business side of your music.
blurb: Business and creative tools for musicians: income, taxes and budgets alongside voice memos, notes and a rhyme dictionary.
features: Track what you earn and what to set aside.
Capture ideas the moment they hit.
Lyrics, plans and to-dos in one place.

name: Bearings
tagline: Learn the outdoors and the world.
blurb: Learn the outdoors and the world: hunting, dogs, current events and a private journal.
features: Training and care for working dogs.
Your thoughts stay on your phone.

name: Card Wallet
tagline: See your cards and debt in one place.
blurb: Keep every card and balance in one place and see your way out of debt.
features: Balances, limits and due dates together.
See how fast each balance can come down.
Your numbers stay on your phone.

name: The Lost Library
blurb: Explore history through the people and dated events that connect it, and compare topics side by side.
features: Dates and the people behind them, pulled together for each topic.
Put two topics side by side and see the parallels.
Jump from a connection to its place in time.
